fact: The 2024 Guinea-Bissau Internet Governance Forum report records a BCEAO speaker stating that STAR-UEMOA, SICA-UEMOA and the GIM-UEMOA card switch operate as online payment infrastructure in Guinea-Bissau and are all regulated by the BCEAO.
title: Relatório do Primeiro Fórum da Governação da Internet - Guiné-Bissau 2024
publisher: Fórum da Governação da Internet da Guiné-Bissau (FGIGB)
